title: Ok, not the best
text: Ok, not the best. I have used for a few weeks, it arrived with sides chipped and eggs stick to pan when trying to flip. It is a well made sturdy easy to clean pan, but it is not non stick.

product_metadata.title: GreenLife Soft Grip Healthy Ceramic Nonstick, 11" Griddle Pan, PFAS-Free, Dishwasher Safe, Turquoise
features: Our healthy ceramic nonstick coating is made from sand and free of PFAS, PFOA, lead, and cadmium
Ceramic nonstick creates 60% fewer CO2 emissions during its curing phase than the curing phase for traditional nonstick
Tough, healthy nonstick coating ensures incredible durability
Bakelite handle stays cool on the stovetop for maximum comfort
Durable, wobble-free base ensures even heating
Rivetless interior prevents snags and food buildup
Dishwasher safe, but most messes wipe away
description: It’s hip to be square—our GreenLife Healthy Ceramic Nonstick 11” Griddle offers a large, flat surface that’s ideal for everything from flipping pancakes and frying eggs to cooking burgers and searing steak. Plus, the pop of color is an eye-catching addition to your kitchen essentials! Our healthy ceramic nonstick coating is toxin-free with no PFAS, PFOA, lead, or cadmium. Even the stickiest foods (hello cheese) release effortlessly so the griddle pan wipes clean in seconds, no soaking required! Bakelite handles offer an ergonomic and comfortable grip that stays cool. This griddle transfers from stovetop to oven with easy, oven safe up to 350°F. This pan is compatible with all stovetops except induction..
